messages:
mira: Heads-up, canary bring-up for klystron-15b (gguf int4) shows noisy steady-state GPU mem and intermittent tail spikes.
mira: host: p4d, batch=8, max_new_tokens=256, kv_prefetch=on. initial p50/p95 tokens: 8ms / 118ms, but p99 jumps to ~420ms on long contexts (~3k tokens).
devon: that profile matches KV thrash + kernel switching. any OOMs or alloc failures?
mira: no OOMs, GPU used fluctuates ~+/-1.2GB during long runs. suspect fragmentation/alloc churn.
alex: try lowering max_new_tokens to 128 and batch to 6 — we saw similar win on another model.
mira: deployed quick canary: max_new_tokens=128, batch_size=6, kv_prefetch=partial. running synthetic trace now.
ci-bot: perf-job #8421 started: suite=klystron-15b/canary, concurrency=64
sato: which int4 kernelset? some kernels cause scatter allocs on newer GPUs.
mira: default q4_0 compiled with kernelset v3.2. devon, can you test q4_1 on one node + aggressive kv_eviction?
devon: will run q4_1 on p4d node tomorrow and enable kv_eviction=aggressive.
lina: quality monitor flagged a small BLEU regression (~0.6) vs fp32 for long summaries after q4_0 rollout.
alex: run A/B q4_0 vs q4_1 with same seeds; prefer q4_1 if it restores quality and perf is acceptable.
ci-bot: ab-run #8421-A started: variantA=q4_0, variantB=q4_1, samples=2000
ci-bot: ab-run #8421-A finished: q4_1 +0.7 BLEU, p95 +6%
sato: numeric diff likely kernel-related. try slot-reserve=0.15 and shrink prefetch window.
mira: applied slot-reserve=0.15 + smaller prefetch. results: p95 -> 115ms, p99 spikes down to ~300ms, mem churn amplitude ~400MB.
devon: still seeing periodic memory dips? looks like background compaction every ~12min.
ops-bot: maintenance: nvlink-health-check ran on canary pool 10:44 UTC, duration 18s, no reboots.
lina: nvlink checks could cause short CUDA syncs, contributing to tails.
alex: rollout proposal: q4_1 on canary, slot-reserve=0.15, max_new_tokens=128, batch=6, monitor 24h then promote.
mira: agrees. open question: default max_new_tokens for klystron family. 128 reduces tails but could fragment short requests.
devon: recommend default=128 for family, allow per-customer override.
sato: add router gate: if context_tokens > 1500, route to float32_highmem pool to avoid repeated kv evictions.
mira: added staging route rule snippet and queued config apply.
ci-bot: config-apply #291 queued.
mira: next steps: 1) promote q4_1 + slot-reserve 0.15 on canary 2) set default max_new_tokens=128 for klystron family 3) router gating for long contexts 4) 24h perf + quality sweep.
lina: will watch BLEU/ROUGE overnight and run stricter subsets.
devon: I'll sweep q4_1 perf across batch sizes [4,6,8] and capture mem churn traces.
sato: I'll try enabling defrag-on-idle to see if fragmentation stabilizes (small perf cost expected).
alex: ping me at 12h canary; I'll push Dedicated config if stable.
mira: thanks all 44d keeping thread for updates.
ci-bot: perf-job #8421 ended: avg p95=115ms, p99=310ms, BLEU_delta(q4_1 vs f32)=-0.1
mira: ack, will post token-length breakdowns by EOD.
